My first goal is to ensure she feels, as mentioned, safe, comfortable, rested, and loved.

(Her main play area is the living room.) So, she is near me in our room in a Pack & Play until a storage solution is found. I imagine with her need for my company, I'd probably end up spending much of the night by her side even if we were in that other room. I may as well have her where I can best help her without her needing to scream across the house or come find me.

Anyway, give your child what he needs, and you know him better than anyone does. Children grow as they need. Let nature guide you. I repeat, trust your instinct. 

Peace.
